svg.aria-label: Four shipping crates on a loading rack, one per Symfony package on Packagist. benmacha/diagram-bundle: Interactive Doctrine ERD, Symfony 5.4–7.x, JSON API, React studio, SVG/PNG/JDL; 64 downloads. benmacha/mousetracker: Self-hosted heatmaps and scroll maps, with session replay, for Symfony; 59 downloads. benmacha/audit-bundle: Audit trail of Doctrine entities, rollback, web interface, REST API; 4 downloads. benmacha/templatebundle: CRUD interface generator, for Symfony; 147 downloads.
